candidates.description: This feature vector represents Thai language script, including common Thai words, morphologic fragments, and sub-word tokens.
This vector represents the Thai consonant character 'ต' (to tao) appearing in various contextual subwords and syllable combinations.
This vector is related to the Thai consonant 'ก' (ko kai) and its various combinations with vowel markers and tone diacritics.
This feature vector represents the Thai letter 'ส' (So Suea) appearing as a suffix, sub-word component, or attached character across various Thai words and syllables.
This vector activates for common Thai word roots and prefixes, particularly related to the verb "to be" (เป็น) and its frequent contextual combinations.
This feature vector represents common Thai possessive words, nouns, and prefixes related to people and entities.
This feature detects non-English text scripts, specifically Thai character sequences and fragments.
This feature vector represents common Latin-derived grammatical suffixes, particularly nominative masculine singular endings and related morphological markers.
Tokens represent subword fragments of the Thai language, often combined with proper nouns or foreign loanwords containing "V" or "L" sounds.
This feature vector activates on common linguistic prefixes and roots across multiple languages, particularly Thai and English.
